prompt: Do universities need to invest more in technology or libraries?
text: In recent years, modern educational institutions face crucial questions regarding infrastructure investment. Although libraries have traditionally served as intellectual centers, technological development provides more accessible sources of academic research. In my perspective, educational administrations should allocate a significant portion of their financial budget to electronic repositories while keeping physical study environments intact.

prompt: Is distance learning as effective as face-to-face instruction?
text: The evolution of digital pedagogy has generated intense debate among educators worldwide. Distance learning certainly offers unparalleled flexibility for diverse student demographics. Nevertheless, empirical evidence indicates that interpersonal engagement and spontaneous classroom discussions remain essential ingredients for deeper cognitive synthesis.
